ActorTalk: Is this some kind of performance art or something?
There's something wrong with this group of Kuroros. I wanted to observe them up close, but then they just formed a circle and trapped me inside out of nowhere.
I tried pushing them away, but these Kuroros would just bounce back to their original positions as soon as I moved them.
Logically speaking, external commands must have been inserted into their low-level control loops.
It's simple. Activate "Scan Vision" in your terminal, cut off this external signal, and take back their default control permissions.
Why is this in my terminal?
It's an emergency module reserved for you, 【kuroname】.
When Babylonia experiences system anomalies or if something happens where regular permissions do not suffice, it can temporarily access system nodes and obtain control.
It's still in development, but we might as well make use of it, now that we have an opportunity to test it out.
